correctness.rationale: All quantifiers and boundary orders checked. For n<3 realization is impossible because one action would need an empty range or disjoint action neighborhoods would need a joint outcome. Each distinct co-singleton requires a distinct action. For odd n, modular midpoint off-diagonal is a permutation of W without i; for even n, the odd subgroup plus infinity construction yields all finite outcomes except i and infinity exactly as prescribed. Symmetry gives both agents. Independent finite checker validated n=3..200 and exhaustive symmetric n=3,4. Symbolic proof, not finite tests, establishes general correctness.

value.rationale: The full co-singleton neighborhood family is a natural model of agents with individual single-outcome vetoes, and the minimum action count is not provided by generic representability. A complete optimum for every carrier size and a sharp boundary at three outcomes, achieved with indistinguishable action sets and swap symmetry, gives an explicit low-complexity realization with the minimum n^2 joint profiles. The combinatorial construction is tied to the motivated game-semantic invariant rather than an arbitrary matrix slice.
